rationale: composition-comparison.md source 0: The optional face-closeup/smile/hand-below-chin bundle changes expression, framing and hand pose. The chin hand would vacate a required key or knob contact; a face-closeup loses complete cable paths. Its mild smile is already represented by baseline "a slight absorbed smile". No distinct compatible local change remains.

composition-comparison.md source 1: The V-sign requires extended separated index/middle fingers with folded ring/little. It would lift or spread the actual two adjacent-key contact or replace knob contact. Preserving attached hand ownership alone is already in the baseline and receives no source credit.

composition-comparison.md source 2: The source requires a different shadow hand pose while the visible person holds both hands down, plus enclosing doorway/window. That whole event conflicts with the retained active hands and surreal=0; it cannot be stripped to an ordinary lamp for credit.

composition-comparison.md source 3: The thumb/index cross is a specific empty-hand crossing, not thumb and index meeting opposite sides of a cutoff knob. It would obscure the required knob boundary or change the operated contact.

composition-comparison.md source 4: A seated ankle-cross with separately traceable shins is compatible ordinary posture. Complete alternative B realizes it with a lower, wider frame. That alternative makes the ports, two-key depression and near-flat screen more foreshortened and smaller; A better supports the existing strict criteria while remaining intimate. Explored only; not retained.

composition-comparison.md source 5: Palms together requires two facing palms and shared-direction fingers. Both hands would leave their separate synth contacts, contradicting the carried left-key/right-knob criterion.

composition-comparison.md source 6: MIDI key/pad data cable to external software or module is a different signal relationship from this retained synth audio-output→interface-input route. Ordinary finger contact and whole cable continuity are already fully stated in the independent baseline; no new contribution is credited.

composition-comparison.md source 7: The chin-cradle requires thumb/chin, index/cheek and same elbow/desk support together. Either acting hand would leave the keys or knob; generic connected-arm reasoning is already baseline review evidence.

composition-comparison.md source 8: An own-hand finger gap exposing an eye moves a working hand in front of the reference face. It conflicts with simultaneous instrument contacts and occludes facial evidence.

composition-comparison.md source 9: Patching contact microphones, pedals and a mixer requires noise-practice context and different instruments. This one synth/interface/laptop setup has neither that primary context nor those owners. Close listening is already the baseline event and earns no fresh contribution.

composition-comparison.md source 10: The complete frontal tableau requires four adult performers and a stage; count and home-studio setting are preserved. Triangular silhouettes cannot be taken as a surrogate for that actual owner arrangement.

composition-comparison.md source 11: A desk-setup tour focused on objects/cables changes the present purpose from making a loop to showing a setup. Generic object/cable organization is already present in the baseline separated routes and clear outlines; no new retained effect.

composition-comparison.md source 12: The flat record, soundbox-to-horn path and hands-away listener are a complete different mechanism. It replaces the preserved synth music-making event and contact roles; generic attentiveness is already in the baseline.

composition-comparison.md source 13: The seated M contour requires low pelvis, raised separated bent knees and simultaneous leg/support visibility. The fixed wooden desk obscures those contours in the necessary downward tabletop view; revealing them would require a larger low-angle posture composition competing with both endpoint and hand-surface assessment. No distinct compatible local repair is established.

composition-comparison.md source 14: Human-scale instrument/table support is compatible guidance but already fully realized by baseline "She sits behind one compact synthesizer at a shallow rectangular desk" plus the entire desk perimeter and clear individual equipment outlines. Confirmation only, not new-source credit.

composition-comparison.md source 15: A true top-down flatlay would hide the reference-guided face and weaken subject presence. Generic raised viewing is already baseline. A retains an independently justified 65-degree view and nearly face-up display to solve the actual shared-view issue; this does not receive source credit or claim the flatlay realization.

composition-comparison.md source 16: A temporally delayed reflection requires an additional impossible timing/reflection event. It is outside the closed repair scope and incompatible with surreal=0; a still frame also cannot prove a beat delay.

composition-comparison.md source 17: Concert press photography carries a public concert setting/event presentation, unlike the preserved one-person dawn home studio. Style is outside the allowed retry dimensions; no local repair is supplied.

composition-comparison.md source 18: The contract-pressure proposition needs a second person, signature box, pen and open-door-directed action, and separately requires adult context. Its actor/count/event/setting/relationship effects conflict with preserved scope, independently of its advisory qualification flag.

composition-comparison.md source 19: A point move toward a broadcast camera replaces hands-on synth work with broadcast-stage choreography. The retained music-making act and quiet home context are not realized by that change.

composition-comparison.md source 20: Sacred stillness is an atmosphere change outside the closed allowed repair dimensions. The independent baseline already has quiet concentration, but it does not assert sacred meaning and no such source meaning is added.

composition-comparison.md source 21: Zines/cash box/gaffer tape/earplugs requires primary punk-practice context and extra objects. That context is absent in this retained electronic loop session; the cable item alone cannot stand in for the whole set or count as new credit.

composition-comparison.md source 22: Fantasy is a style change outside the retry scope; it provides no ordinary contact, port or projection refinement. The preserved photograph stays in ordinary physical reality.
composition-comparison.md source 23: Fine-art/gallery is a broad style proposal outside allowed retry dimensions. It supplies no concrete distinct repair of the current contact or display relation.

composition-comparison.md source 24: The casting/digitals source combines frontal readable facial planes, soft frontal daylight and restrained surface treatment, with human/portrait-type context conditions. Whole-source casting framing and its adult-face relation are not adopted and no age is inferred. Its ordinary photographic light reasoning supports one independent local refinement: A adds "A broad soft bounce of the existing window daylight from the pale wall behind the camera gently fills her facial planes" in open lighting. Baseline only motivated side-window/task light and separation of hands/ports, so this facial fill is a real new effect. It preserves the same face/hair and physical room light.

composition-comparison.md source 25: The electronic surface source separates keys/knobs/cables under restrained light. This confirms baseline distinct contacts, individually outlined equipment and separated routes; its material effect is outside local scope and no new antennas/pads/faders are added. No fresh source contribution.

composition-comparison.md source 26: The bakehouse proposition requires two people, one loaf and four below-loaf supporting contacts. Those owners/count/event cannot be retained in this synth scene. Its wrist-gap wording is not adopted as a surrogate whole-source arrangement; baseline already keeps separate arm chains.

composition-comparison.md source 27: The MIDI two-hand pose with visible external sound destination confirms baseline separate keys/knob hands and computer display. The source data/external-sound semantics are not the preserved audio route, and its adult-performer wording is not inferred from a portrait. No new effect survives beyond the independent baseline.

composition-comparison.md source 28: A palm bracing on the seat beside/behind the pelvis removes one hand from its required operated surface. The current seated support is already reviewed without such a brace; this specific contact is not compatible.

composition-comparison.md source 29: The near-table portrait bundle places a face above the table, acting hands on its surface and supporting objects around it. All these relations preexist literally in the baseline. Reframing them as a newly discovered contribution would double-count; confirmation only.

composition-comparison.md source 6: MIDI key/pad data cable to external software or module is a different signal relationship from this retained synth audio-output→interface-input route. Ordinary finger contact and whole cable continuity are already fully stated in the independent baseline; no new contribution is credited.

composition-comparison.md source 7: The chin-cradle requires thumb/chin, index/cheek and same elbow/desk support together. Either acting hand would leave the keys or knob; generic connected-arm reasoning is already baseline review evidence.
